themes.note: Six themes of the same roles, from src/styles/tokens.css; picker metadata in src/theme/themes.ts. Frontmatter colors are Coral (default). 'auto' resolves to Coral by day and Night when the device is dark. Saved names from older builds map via LEGACY_THEMES (harbor->sky, lilac->grape, newsprint->lemon, forest->mint, plus the daisyUI names). --cat-* colours are shared by every theme and never redefined.

display.purpose: Landing hero title; 40px phone, 72px desktop, max 15ch. The typed demo line is 32px / 56px.

headline.purpose: Page titles; 34px phone, 44px desktop. Settings section titles 24px.

title.purpose: Bare-input song title in the accent header card; 30px phone, 38px desktop.

headword.purpose: The finished word heading the suggestion sheet; the wordmark at 22px.

lyric.purpose: The writing surface; 18px phone, 19px desktop, 1.85 leading, max 48rem.

body.purpose: Running text and fields (16px prevents iOS zoom).

chip.purpose: Suggested words; weight 650 / 600 / 500 by match strength.

control.purpose: Pill buttons, sentence case; 14px in the small size.

label.purpose: Sentence-case field labels and tags in ink-2.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Cards and the docked suggestion card floating on the tinted ground.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The phone suggestion sheet lifting upward.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and press changes on buttons, tabs, fields and checks.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile press on buttons and word chips.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Suggestion sheet height between peek, half and full (phone only).

motion.name: headword-in
motion.purpose: Headword lifts 0.3em and fades from 45% opacity when a new word is finished.

motion.name: loading-run
motion.purpose: Accent pill running along the loading track.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All of the above switch off under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Below: dialogs become bottom sheets. From: notebook cards in two columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Dark rail (224px) replaces the tab bar; suggestion sheet becomes a docked 320px card; page gutter 40px.

narrative.overview:
Every song is a bright, friendly object. It opens on a header card filled with the theme's accent, carrying the song's title in heavy white (or dark, on light accents) type, and the words that answer it arrive as chips tinted in their category's colour. The rest of the page stays calm: a softly tinted ground, white writing and suggestion surfaces floating on soft warm shadows, and one dark nav that anchors the screen.

Colour does two separate jobs and never mixes them. The theme accent says "this is your song" (the header card, the landing hero, the accent button, focus and caret). The eight fixed category colours say "this kind of word" (suggestion pills, word chips, and the note tiles that borrow them), and they stay the same in every theme so a writer learns "coral is rhymes" once. Density is phone-first: 44px touch targets, pill controls, and the same layout grows into a rail, editor and docked suggestion card on desktop.

The world rejects the grey notes app and the stark print look it replaced: no square corners, no heavy rules, no all-caps labels, no muted samey themes, no plain word grids.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted ground, white floating surfaces, one dark nav; six themes re-colour the same roles.
The accent fills each song's header card; it is a surface, not just a marker.
Eight fixed category colours code every suggestion and tile each note.
Raleway Variable throughout: 800 titles, 650-700 sentence-case labels and controls, 450 body and lyrics.
Pills and 14-32px radii everywhere; nothing square.
Soft, warm-tinted ambient shadows; depth is gentle lift, never hard edges.

rules.name: The Two Colour Jobs Rule
rules.body: The theme accent means "your song"; category colours mean "kind of word". A category colour never marks app state, and the accent never codes a word type.

rules.name: The Category Colours Hold Still Rule
rules.body: The eight `--cat-*` values are identical in every theme. Theme blocks never redefine them.

rules.name: The Every Theme Is AA Rule
rules.body: ink, ink-2 and accent-text on sleeve and surface; on-accent on accent; on-panel, on-panel-2 and panel-accent on panel; white on every category colour: all at least 4.5:1 in every theme.

rules.name: The Roles Not Values Rule
rules.body: Components read semantic roles only. A theme is nothing but a block of role values; the one sanctioned literal is white text on a solid category colour.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, tabs and buttons are sentence case with no added tracking. Uppercase tracked lines are not part of this world.

rules.name: The 800 Is For Names Rule
rules.body: 800 belongs to things with names: page titles, song titles, the headword, the wordmark, tile initials. Lyrics stay 450.

rules.name: The Thumb Holds Still Rule
rules.body: When a new word is finished, only the headword and chips change; category pills and the sheet height stay where the thumb left them.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are wide, low-opacity and theme-tinted. No hard offset shadows, no dark outlines to fake lift.

rules.name: The No Square Corners Rule
rules.body: Nothing interactive or containing has a 0 radius; the only straight edges are 1px dividers.

dos: Do read only semantic roles so all six themes stay correct, and keep the eight category colours fixed across themes.
Do fill each song's header card with the theme accent and put white surfaces for writing and suggestions on the tinted ground.
Do colour suggestions by category: solid for the selected pill, 6-30% tints toward surface for chips, fading with match strength.
Do use pills for every control and 14-24px radii for containers.
Do set titles at 800 with -0.02em, labels and controls in sentence case at 650-700, lyrics at 450 with 1.85 leading.
Do keep tap targets at 44px (word chips, buttons, icon buttons, menu items, nav rows) and field text at 16px.
Do lift surfaces with the soft, theme-tinted shadows from the Elevation section.
Do honour reduced motion: the sheet, headword lift, chip press, loading run and control transitions all switch off.
donts: Don't use square corners, heavy rules or four-sided ink outlines.
Don't set labels, tabs or buttons in uppercase or add letter-spacing to them.
Don't use a category colour to mark app state, or the theme accent to code a word type.
Don't redefine `--cat-*` inside a theme block or add a theme that fails any AA pair.
Don't show suggestions as a plain word grid; they are tinted chips.
Don't use hard offset shadows or dark outlines for lift.
Don't add a second typeface; Raleway Variable is the only family.
Don't let a new lookup move the category pills or the sheet height under the writer's thumb.
